title: Dynamic Entanglement Distribution for Multi-User and Multi-Protocol Quantum Networking
summary: Dynamic entanglement distribution is a key requirement for scalable, multi-user and multi-protocol quantum networks. We demonstrate a metropolitan-scale entanglement-based quantum communication network enabled by a quantum reconfigurable optical add-drop multiplexer (q-ROADM), which dynamically distributes polarisation-entangled photon pairs from a broadband source to six users over deployed campus and metropolitan fibre.
